<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.py - do not edit by hand. -->

Generate the project's sync catalog (P1 mermaid + P2 json).

## Usage

```bash
drt docs generate [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output`, `-o` | `PATH` | `target/docs` | Output directory. |
| `--format`, `-f` | `TEXT` | `html` | Output format: html \| mermaid \| json. |
| `--no-state` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Exclude per-sync run state, run history, and DLQ depth from the manifest. |
| `--full-labels` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Show verbatim connection labels (endpoints, hosts, phone/email) and unredacted error text instead of the default docs-safe output (#696/#698). For trusted/internal hosting only. |
| `--history-depth` | `INTEGER RANGE` | `10` | Recent runs per sync to embed in the manifest from .drt/history (schema v2, #698). 0 disables; ignored with --no-state. |
| `--inline` | `BOOLEAN` |  | HTML only: emit the whole catalog as ONE self-contained, navigable HTML object — inlined CSS/JS + in-page (#hash) navigation — so it renders AND navigates on an authenticated object store (GCS / S3), where per-object auth breaks the multi-file output's sub-resources and cross-links (#818/#821). Display is byte-identical to the default multi-file output. |
